$comment: The Aphelion system. Shared by every mission; missions reference bodies by id. Mirrored by tools/refsim/universe.py — change both together.

bodies.name: Halcyon
bodies.$rotation_note: 6-hour sidereal day; the equator carries you 186.2 m/s eastward for free.
bodies.description: A temperate world with a shallow but grabby atmosphere. Low orbit begins around 90 km; below 70 km the air will find you.

bodies.name: Lyra
bodies.$rotation_note: Tidally locked: spin period equals the 37.787 h orbital period.
bodies.description: Halcyon's single airless moon, tidally locked, 37.8 hours to the revolution. No atmosphere means no aerobraking and no parachutes — you land on thrust alone.
